agriculture.meaning: Classifies agricultural relevance; production and population remain exact civil-economy and population facts.

artillery.meaning: Classifies artillery emplacement/service relevance; exact engines, ammunition, crews and firing geometry remain separate exact authorities.

barracks.meaning: Classifies permanent military housing/service infrastructure; it never creates troops, beds, or capacity without exact infrastructure owners.

battlefield.meaning: Marks a site suitable for battlefield/campaign reference; exact contact and combat require saved geometry and participating formations.

chokepoint.meaning: Marks strategic constriction relevance; exact movement/control effects still come from routes, fortifications, terrain, and current control state.

engineering.meaning: Classifies military/civil engineering activity; exact works, tools, materials, labor and projects remain in their authoritative owners.

fortification.meaning: Location is relevant to fortification routing; actual fortification geometry and condition come from fortification profiles and exact fortification state.

house.meaning: Associates a site with House activity or identity without creating House authority or resources.

household.meaning: Classifies household use; residence does not prove current presence, access, or relationship state.

information.meaning: Locality can support lawful report, intelligence, rumor, or message delivery when provenance and route conditions permit.

inspection.meaning: Classifies a site as relevant to inspection/investigation scenes; evidence still requires an exact investigation or information path.

market.meaning: Supports market-weighted civil activity and merchant information routes; it never creates stock or capital by tag alone.

medical.meaning: Can satisfy location-based medical facility requirements such as surgery when all exact people and treatment conditions are also valid.

military.meaning: Suitable for military access/activity and military report routing; troop presence and command remain exact formation/force facts.

movement.meaning: Suitable as a movement or military-column access destination; strategic routing still comes from the route graph.

muster.meaning: Classifies a muster-capable venue; it creates no troops and does not bypass exact force or formation conservation.

pasture.meaning: Classifies pasture and horse-economy relevance; living mounts remain exact conserved owners while pasture is an economic/geographic support factor.

politics.meaning: Supports political/official information routing; it does not prove audience, office access, control, or recognition.

recruitment.meaning: Locality may contribute recruitment access/weight; conserved bodies still come from exact population and force owners.

scene.meaning: Useful as a physical scene/reference venue; by itself grants no population, stock, authority, access, or strategic effect.

supply.meaning: Suitable for military/logistics activity; actual stock and transfers come from exact depot, economy, formation, and contract owners.

taxation.meaning: Locality participates in weighted civil tax allocation; exact population, treasury, and territorial owners remain authoritative.

trade.meaning: Classifies trade relevance for reference and simulation routing; exact goods, prices, capital, and contracts live in economy owners.

training.meaning: Suitable for formation/group training access where the command also satisfies current authority, co-location, and time rules.

tribal_territory.meaning: Classifies a tribal territorial locality; it does not create polity recognition, population, troops, or control.

role_semantics.delivery_channel: Consumed by lawful report/information delivery routing.
role_semantics.mechanical_gate: Consumed directly by at least one current runtime eligibility check.
role_semantics.reference_tag: Semantic/reference classification only; it must not manufacture mutable state.
role_semantics.scene_anchor: Presentation/reference venue only unless additional current mechanics independently apply.
role_semantics.simulation_weight: Consumed by current deterministic aggregate simulation weighting.
role_semantics.strategic_classification: Used to classify strategic sites while exact geometry/control lives elsewhere.
